introHtml: Acrylic salt and pepper shakers offer a sleek, modern look that stands out on any tabletop. Unlike glass or ceramic, acrylic is shatter-resistant and lightweight, making it ideal for high-traffic restaurants, catering events, or outdoor picnics where breakage is a concern. Customize with your logo using screen printing or pad printing for a crisp, durable finish that won't fade after repeated use. Perfect for branded giveaways that will be used daily.
